classification.classification_reason: The article is about Dhinakaran's political stance on inflation in Tamil Nadu.

content.title: Dhinakaran Urges Tamil Nadu Govt to Control Inflation
content.caption: Tamil Nadu's AMMK general secretary urges the TVK-led government to take measures to control price rise and inflation.

slides.heading: Dhinakaran Urges Tamil Nadu Govt to Control Inflation
slides.text: Tamil Nadu's AMMK general secretary urges the TVK-led government to take measures to control price rise and inflation.

slides.heading: Price Rise and Inflation in Tamil Nadu
slides.text: Tamil Nadu ranks first in India in price rise and inflation, with retail inflation at 7.29%.

slides.heading: Efforts to Control Inflation
slides.text: Dhinakaran demands the government to abandon false propaganda and take constructive measures to control price rise and inflation.
